abilities.descEn: When the Ranger is defeated, it will randomly take 1 of the enemies with it. It has a high chance of activating in PVP and Guild War only, and will not activate in other battles. (Guardians will not be affected by this Ability)
abilities.descZh: 擁有此能力的Ranger被打倒時，會帶著隨機1名敵人同歸於盡。此技能僅會在PVP和公會戰中以高機率發動，其餘戰鬥中則不會發動。（隨機選擇對象不包含守護者）

abilities.descEn: Frequently avoids the effects of Ice Shot and Blizzard items.
abilities.descZh: 該Ranger能夠以高機率閃避「發射冰／暴風雪」的道具效果。

abilities.descEn: Frequently produces 2 Rangers for the Mineral cost of 1 Ranger.
abilities.descZh: 以高機率只消耗生產1隻Ranger所需的礦物量就生產出2隻Ranger。

abilities.descEn: Has a high chance of creating a powerful shield that can't be broken for 5 seconds when Rangers deploy. Prevents attack and instant kill effects while the shield is up.\n\n- The defense effects of said Ability only apply to Rangers' Skills and Ability attacks.
abilities.descZh: 出動時能以高機率在5秒內形成無法被解除的強力防護罩。防護罩形成中可抵擋攻擊和立即消滅的效果。\n\n※該能力的防禦效果對象僅限於Ranger的技能和能力攻擊。
